evidence: C1/C5 sit adjacent to U1 pins 1-2 (GND/3V3), but C2 (+3V3) is placed near header J2 roughly 10+ mm from any IC power pin, not immediately adjacent to the pin it decouples.

The EN button chain (SW2/R1) sits center-right while U1's EN pin (pin 3) is on the module's left side, and UART ratsnest from right-side TXD/RXD pins doubles back diagonally across the bottom pin row to reach J2.
No relay/ADC terminal pin rows exist; J2's UART_RX/UART_TX order matches U1's TXD/RXD vertical pin order so the straight pad-to-pad lines do not cross.
The ESP32 module's antenna faces the top board edge with a dashed keepout region between module and edge that is free of components and copper in both 2D and 3D top views.
Power enters at edge connector J1 (USB-C, bottom-left) and flows through bulk cap C2 toward U1 with no discrete regulator stage present, so placement reads input -> filter -> load in order.
